hotel_name: Trump International Hotel & Tower, New York

claims.text: The hotel's address is 1 Central Park West, New York.

findings.quote: 1 CENTRAL PARK WEST, NEW YORK, NEW YORK 10023
1 Central Park West, New York, New York 10023

claims.text: The hotel sits across from Central Park on Columbus Circle, in a 52-story building.

findings.quote: Across from Central Park on Columbus Circle, this 52-story hotel is a great home base for sight-seeing.

claims.text: The hotel is steps from Columbus Circle, Lincoln Center and Fifth Avenue.

findings.quote: Located steps from Columbus Circle, Lincoln Center, and Fifth Avenue

claims.text: Suites come with one, two, three or four bedrooms.

findings.quote: as well as some of the best suites in NYC, with one, two, three, and four bedrooms

claims.text: The hotel has suites with kitchens.

findings.quote: our suites with kitchens provide a home-away-from-home experience

claims.text: Rooms are apartment-style, with a color palette of gray, aubergine, ivory and caramel.

findings.quote: Each apartment-style room has a sophisticated color palette of gray, aubergine, ivory, and caramel

claims.text: Rooms have Schonbek crystal chandeliers over the dining table and rosewood, mahogany, maple and walnut finishes.

findings.quote: with Schonbek crystal chandeliers over the dining table and rosewood, mahogany, maple, and walnut finishes

claims.text: Both Jean Georges and Nougatine are run by Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

findings.quote: Both Jean Georges and Nougatine are run by Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

claims.text: Nougatine is a more casual expression of Jean-Georges, set between Central Park views and an exhibition kitchen.

findings.quote: A more casual expression of Jean-Georges, Nougatine by Jean-Georges is nestled between sweeping Central Park views and the restaurant’s exhibition kitchen.

claims.text: Nougatine's menu features signature Jean-Georges dishes alongside seasonal daily specials.

findings.quote: The menu features signature Jean-Georges dishes alongside seasonal daily specials

claims.text: The hotel offers the personalized Trump Attache service.

findings.quote: including the personalized Trump Attaché® service exclusive to Trump Hotels

claims.text: The hotel's Concierge team personally recommends curated New York City experiences.

findings.quote: Curated experiences, iconic dining, world-class culture, and hidden moments, personally recommended by our award-winning Concierge team

claims.text: In the warmer months, the park-facing Mistral Terrace has Dedon furniture designed by Philippe Starck and serves the full Nougatine menu with signature cocktails.

findings.quote: During the warmer months, the park-facing Mistral Terrace features Dedon furniture designed by Philippe Starck and offers the full Nougatine menu alongside signature cocktails.

claims.text: Every room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Central Park and the Manhattan skyline.

findings.quote: Each room and suite boasts stunning floor-to-ceiling windows that showcase captivating panoramas of Central Park and the Manhattan skyline.

claims.text: At evening turndown, water is served in Rogaska glasses.

findings.quote: at evening turndown, water is served in Rogaska glasses.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2024 and 2025.

findings.quote: Readers' Choice Awards 2017, 2018, 2019, 2024, 2025

claims.text: Travelers of all ages are welcome, but guests must be 21 or older to check into their own room.

findings.quote: We welcome travelers of all ages, however guests must be 21 years or older to check into their own room.

claims.text: The hotel is 100% smoke free, and a $1,000 cleaning fee applies to any room where smoking is apparent.

findings.quote: We are a 100% smoke free hotel. A $1,000 cleaning fee will be applied to any guest room where smoking is apparent.

claims.text: Business casual attire is required at Nougatine, and its outdoor seating is weather dependent.

findings.quote: Business casual attire is required. Outdoor seating is weather dependent.
